messages:
Alex (ACME): Hey team — after we moved the ACME org under a new parent last night, our pipelines started getting 403s from both the Console and the API. Project is acme-payments (proj_42). Service account svc-billing@acme and multiple users that had project-editor lost access. No config changes on our side. Can someone triage?

Maya (Support): Sorry you're hitting this. Can you paste the exact curl (or SDK call) and the full response body? Also send the org/project ids and any request_id from the responses. We'll check logs and org-transfer activity.

Alex (ACME): Repro below — same result from both UI and API.
```
# curl from our job
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/projects/proj_42/invoices

Response:
{
  "error": "permission_denied",
  "message": "403 Forbidden: missing project.access view_invoices",
  "request_id": "req_0a1b2c"
}
```
Org: org_1001 (target), original org: org_987. Project: proj_42.

Maya (Support): thanks. I can see an org transfer event for org_987 -> org_1001 on 2026-03-14T03:22:11Z. The transfer migration run set "inherit_roles": false on the target org due to a policy conflict. That would drop effective project-level permissions if services were relying on org inheritance. I'm going to loop in Eng-Auth to confirm.

Jordan (Eng-Auth): Looking. We rolled a migration that attempts to preserve effective bindings by translating org-level group assignments to project-level role_bindings during transfer. There's a known edge-case where if the destination org has an explicit deny policy or conflicting group with a different scope, our migration toggles role inheritance off as a safety. It looks like that was triggered here and we didn't recreate all project-level bindings — hence the 403s.

Jordan (Eng-Auth): Short term workarounds you can try: 1) re-enable role inheritance on the target org (if it is safe for you), or 2) create explicit project-level role bindings for svc-billing@acme and affected users, or 3) create a new project-scoped API key and use that until we patch. Example admin commands below.

# Re-enable inheritance via admin CLI (requires org admin token)
rdmctl auth set-role-inheritance --org org_1001 --enable true

# Or via control plane API (internal admin endpoint)
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.redwood.internal/v1/orgs/org_1001/inheritance" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"inherit_roles":true}'

# Example: add project-level binding for the service account
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.redwood.internal/v1/projects/proj_42/role_bindings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"principal":"svc-billing@acme","role":"project.viewer"}'

Jordan (Eng-Auth): We'll also create a targeted migration job to re-hydrate missing bindings for this transfer. I've opened ticket AUTH-3294, assigned to @jordan, priority P1 for the migration rollback/repair. ETA for patch: ~24 hours, with a hotfix rollout to the control plane tomorrow. We'll also add a safety log to avoid flipping inherit_roles without a second pass.

Maya (Support): For the immediate path of least friction — if you can accept re-enabling inheritance, run the first command. If not, we can add explicit bindings for the svc account and your user groups. If you want us to do the binding change for you, please confirm we can act with an admin token on org_1001 and provide a primary contact.

Alex (ACME): Rebinding the svc account to project.viewer via the API worked — invoices endpoint now returns 200 and the scheduled job succeeded. Thanks! Leaving the thread open until the AUTH-3294 fix is in so we don't have to manually rebind other projects. :white_check_mark:

Jordan (Eng-Auth): Great. We'll run the rehydration for org_1001 and post the run log here once complete. Tracking in AUTH-3294.

CI Bot: Deployment scheduled: auth-migration-fix v1.2.3 -> canary at 2026-03-15T02:00:00Z, full rollout 2026-03-15T06:00:00Z.

Maya (Support): Marking as monitored. Please ping if anything else pops up. :pray:
